current_activity: division attacks along the crests of the Lower Vosges, supplied by pack mules, in the VI Corps attack
notes: Event date: 15 March 1945 (Last Offensive ch. 12 p. 254: on the corps left wing the 42d Infantry Division, attacking along the spine of the Lower Vosges, avoided the roads and villages and followed the crests; pack mules supplied the troops; the CMH table lists the command post at Wimmenau on 15 March). Event definition: the division attacks with VI Corps in the opening of the Seventh Army's Saar-Palatinate offensive; the row places the headquarters.
